aggregation_correction.reason: NumPy Boolean in criterion_met prevented summary JSON writing after all 3000 trials completed.
aggregation_correction.scope: All simulation/input function identities, runtime versions, seed identities and protocol match. Only aggregate JSON scalar normalization changed.

protocol.acceptance: At all 1000 trials per scenario, Bonferroni-simultaneous exact lower Monte Carlo bounds must exceed .80 for confirmation probability and .90 for interval availability. Refusals count as nonconfirmations. Coverage diagnostics and all limitations remain separate.
protocol.diagnostic_allocation: .05 / (3 scenarios * 2 endpoints); two-sided exact binomial intervals are conservative for these lower-bound diagnostics.
protocol.population: Same locked null generators plus a fixed +1 contribution for every member event. Unequal independent clusters retain event weighting.
protocol.product_status: Experimental candidate; not enabled. Extreme tails, multiple hypotheses, transformations, support envelopes and complete product qualification remain required.
protocol.rationale: Useful power for a predeclared large unit-standard-deviation contrast; this does not impose a universal product effect threshold or promise power at smaller effects.

scope: Power and availability only; does not supersede the retained null/coverage diagnostics or qualify the disabled candidate generally.
